ops.title: Coalesce read-triggered query graph retirement with writes
ops.description: Owner /root. Read-after-write queries reclaim old active graphs inline; captured traces show606208-618496bytes written to authority-v2.db. Draft PR215 uses one retired generation per binding, reclaims with the next writer in the existing reference-count batch, and drains an occupied slot before replacement. Cache format and pin-retirement timing unchanged. Next: independent ownership/design review, hosted contract and fully-drained allocation proof, cost measurements, then official release/local CLI+helper installation and affected-case verification. Evidence ~/.vcache/scratch/cost-retro-20261102/ccn-query-writeback-attribution.json; source ~/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-notes/query-retirement-nov4. No local load tests or protected-session changes.
